findings.entity: small glass bowl -> large jar transfer
findings.description: Dark purple/black olives are seen falling into and resting in the large jar, but the source small glass bowl showed exclusively green olives at 00:00. The bowl is transparent glass, so dark olives should have been visible if present; they arrive with no visible source containing dark olives. Partially mitigated by possible occlusion under the green olives in the pile and by the hand gripping the bowl.

The small glass bowl appears nearly empty at 00:04 after pouring, but at 00:06 (immediately after a camera cut) it again holds ~6-8 green olives. No refill action is shown; a legitimate off-screen refill (e.g., scooping from the stainless steel bowl, whose olive count slightly drops across the cut) could explain it, so this is noted at lower confidence rather than certainty.
